Name: Stardew Valley Weed Tycoon
Author: algebroom
Description:
[b][center][size=4][font=Times New Roman]MARLOWE THE NPC HAS NOW BEEN RELEASED. ALL HEART EVENTS AND FESTIVALS. IF YOU HAVE DOWNLOADED PREVIOUS VERSIONS OF THE SEPARATE FILES, [b][i]MAKE SURE TO DELETE THE OLD FILES AS THEY HAVE ALL BEEN MERGED UNDER THE ONE FOLDER![/i][/b]

[/font][/size][font=Times New Roman][size=3]NPC WIP
[/size][/font]
[youtube]yGy1UwUOkTY[/youtube][/center]
!!! DRUGS AND IMPLIED USE !!![/b]
Ever wondered where Seb and Sam got their weed from? Probably from an outside source, and that can have plenty of drawbacks. So, why don't you be a good neighbour and grow it for them? They'll love it! Not sure the other town folks will, though...

To get around Lewis calling in the city cops, because there isn't actually any police in town, you sneak him some of the profits. (Not like he isn't already taking a portion of your profits anyway). The rest of the town doesn't really care. 


[center][/center][center][font=Times New Roman]﻿[size=4][b]INSTRUCTIONS[/b][/size][/font][/center][size=4][size=2]
[size=3]The seeds can be found in Pierre's store for 70g in Summer or Fall, since those are the two seasons it grows.[/size][/size][size=3] They grow in 13 days and can only be harvested once.

[/size][/size]
[b]MY FIRST STARDEW MOD! A little rough around the edges, but it's literally my first ever mod. (second if you count a retexture in another
game)
[/b]Any issues, please let me know! Also, sorry for the manual only download, since Vortex doesn't work for my Stardew mods so I can't
test it. However, all you need to do to for the [b]installation [/b]is drop the zip file into 'Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods'. Make sure you have 'JsonAssets' installed first!
